name: Brompton Split Banc Corp.
summary: Brompton Split Banc Corp. is a close-ended equity mutual fund launched and managed by Brompton Funds Limited. The fund invests in the public equity markets of Canada. It seeks to invest in stocks of companies primarily engaged in the banking sector. The fund benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the S&P/TSX Capped Financials Index. Brompton Split Banc Corp. was formed on September 14, 2005 and is domiciled in Canada.
